cumleler: Which change counts as an alarm in workplace hearing monitoring?
The US OSHA definition of standard threshold shift uses only three frequencies.
They are 2000, 3000 and 4000 hertz, where noise damage appears first.
An average worsening of 10 decibels or more from baseline counts.
In the example, shifts of 10, 15 and 15 average about 13.
The shift is confirmed by retesting; one measurement is not enough.
